On February 10, 2026, a mass shooting occurred in Tumbler Ridge, British Columbia, Canada. On that afternoon, Jesse Van Rootselaar killed her mother and half-brother at their home before going to Tumbler Ridge Secondary School, where she killed six people and injured 27 others before killing herself. Van Rootselaar was a former student of the school.
The attacker's mother and 11-year-old half brother were shot and killed with a shotgun at their home at Fellers Avenue in Tumbler Ridge. Police had already been called to the school when a surviving resident of the home and neighbours alerted them to this attack; the Vancouver Sun reported that the surviving resident was the 8-year-old half-brother of the shooter.
Van Rootselaar then went to Tumbler Ridge Secondary School and opened fire, first killing a victim in a stairwell. She killed five others in the school's library and fatally shot herself shortly after police arrived.
